verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents its own API for core card operations: creating cards as paymentInstrument resources, updating cards via /paymentInstruments/{id} requests, and raising disputes through the Raise disputes API. Coverage is incomplete because some workflows are documented only through the Customer Area UI: configuring relayed authorisation webhooks, uploading dispute packages (a pilot feature), and viewing card payments. No machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. missing for 10: documented API coverage for relayed-authorisation configuration, dispute file upload and card payment viewing; a discoverable OpenAPI spec; independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
